browser.numerical_disclosure_text:
Does a smaller time step change the result?

RK4 samples the current at the start, two estimated midpoints and an estimated endpoint, then combines those slopes. Smaller steps refine this calculation; they do not supply new current measurements.

The layout recommendation is unchanged across the tested contact intervals. All six releases complete the forcing horizon in every numerical run.

1 · Change the integration step

Requested RK4 steps of 300, 150 and 75 seconds are compared only at common accepted output times, 300 seconds apart. The 75-second run is a numerical reference, not observed truth. Actual substeps may be shortened at forcing knots, spatial limits or the horizon.

Position sensitivity · the same six hypothetical releases
Requested step	Largest separation from 75 s	Comparable releases	Forcing coverage
300 s	0.00084 m	6 / 6	6 complete · 0 partial · 0 unavailable
150 s	0.000326 m	6 / 6	6 complete · 0 partial · 0 unavailable
75 s · reference	0 m · self-comparison	6 / 6	6 complete · 0 partial · 0 unavailable

Largest position difference across these numerical runs: 0.00084 m. A comparable prefix can still end before the requested six-hour horizon; it is not a complete forecast.

2 · Change only the contact-check spacing

All three rows reuse the same fine trajectory, integrated and saved every 75 seconds. Selecting points 300, 150 or 75 seconds apart changes only the straight chords used to find first reef or interceptor contact. The terminal accepted point is retained even for partial paths.

Predicted reef-entry bounds · denominator stays six per layout
Contact spacing	No interceptor	Layout A	Layout B	Recommendation
300 s	6 / 6	2 / 6 · 0 unresolved	4 / 6 · 0 unresolved	Layout A
150 s	6 / 6	2 / 6 · 0 unresolved	4 / 6 · 0 unresolved	Layout A
75 s	6 / 6	2 / 6 · 0 unresolved	4 / 6 · 0 unresolved	Layout A

Layout A: Central coverage. Layout B: Flanking coverage. Missing or unsupported outcomes stay in the upper entry bound; they never become zero entries.

Contact matching and incomplete comparisons

Numerical precision is not physical accuracy. The forcing is still roughly 4 km / three-hour model data. Agreement does not establish fourth-order convergence, improved ML skill, real collection efficiency or reef protection. No tank observations or independent truth enter this check, and it does not replace the main layout decision paths.
